text:
harper: Heads-up: after enabling a lightweight edge heartbeat compression in the EU canary, we started seeing short reconnect storms and duplicate billing for some long-lived SSE streams. console alert ALRT-5501. anyone digging? :grimacing:

diego: saw that. p95 reconnects jumped for a cohort. link to alert: https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-5501

harper: logs (redacted):
```
2026-05-04T03:21:10Z INFO heartbeat recv: id=rt-77 header=hb-v2
2026-05-04T03:21:11Z INFO resume attempt: session=rt-77 shard=eu-west-2
2026-05-04T03:21:11Z WARN reconnect: quick-retry session=rt-77 hit=eu-central-1
2026-05-04T03:21:12Z INFO billed_tokens session=rt-77 tokens=58
```

lin: pattern looks like edge sent hb-v2 (short form) while the origin proxy expected hb-v1 and treated the reconnection as a fresh session. That caused a full regen/billing on the new shard. Also our sampling for reconnect traces is 0.5% so console missed the per-shard correlation until billing picked it up.

diego: two immediate diagnostics: 1) bump reconnect/heartbeat sampling to 10% for eu region for 30m 2) add a per-shard duplicate_tokens tile to the canary dashboard with tenant drilldown.

harper: agree. also thinking of a short sticky affinity window (12s) after heartbeat-policy flips to prefer the previous shard for resumes. reduces double-regens while we debug header semantics.

lin: long-term fix: unify heartbeat header versions at the edge/proxy boundary or add a small compatibility shim that translates hb-v2->hb-v1 for legacy proxies. Low-risk, but needs a rollout.

product-console: UX note: the rollout page currently doesn't surface telemetry sampling; we should add a small banner suggesting increased sampling during route-sensitive changes. will mock a CTA.

diego: another low-risk guard: add a lightweight resume-idempotency cache in the billing pipeline keyed by (resume_id, tenant_id) with ttl=6s to ignore near-duplicate bills. Cheap and reversible.

ops-bot: [automated] Alert ALRT-5501 acknowledged by harper. Incident INC-5510 created.

harper: plan of action:
- diego: bump reconnect/heartbeat sample_frac for eu -> 0.1 (30m) and push per-shard duplicate chart (doing now)
- lin: roll sticky previous-shard affinity TTL=12s on canary (soft-fallback)
- diego: add tenant drilldown to duplicate_tokens tile and monitor query cost
- lin: start compat shim RFC for heartbeat header translation
- product-console: add rollout sampling CTA and help text
- harper: monitor, rollback canary if duplicate billing doesn't fall in 10m

diego: quick console query: duplicate_tokens spike concentrated on shard eu-central-1 and correlates with route-change at T+2m. original shard CPU +14%. pushing dashboard panel now.

harper: sampling bump active. watching traces. :eyes:

lin: small defensive snippet we can add to billing pipeline while RFC is in flight:
```
# pseudocode
if billing_cache.get((resume_id, tenant_id)):
  ignore_charge()
else:
  billing_cache.set((resume_id, tenant_id), true, ttl=6)
  process_charge()
```

diego: love it. low risk. I'll prototype and run it behind a feature flag.

product-console: will prototype rollout CTA and surface sampling fraction on canary page this week.

harper: if counts don't drop in 10m we rollback the heartbeat compression change on the EU canary. thanks all. :thumbsup:
